name: no_duplicate_entities_in_single_field
rationale: Correct outputs will not have duplicate entities within any single field. This catches outputs that redundantly list the same entity in a field multiple times.

name: no_unrelated_words_as_entities
rationale: Correct outputs only include entities that are substrings of the input text. This catches outputs containing extraneous or unrelated words.

name: no_empty_strings_in_fields
rationale: Correct outputs never include empty strings as entities in any field. This catches outputs with improperly extracted empty entities.

name: entities_in_correct_order
rationale: Correct outputs list entities in the order they appear in the text. This catches outputs with improperly reordered entities.

name: no_whitespace_only_entities
rationale: Correct outputs do not include entities that are just whitespace. This catches outputs with invalid or improperly trimmed entities.

name: no_numeric_entities_in_person_field
rationale: Correct outputs never include purely numeric entities in the "person" field. This catches outputs that misclassify numbers as people.

name: no_non_alphanumeric_art_entities
rationale: Correct outputs do not classify non-alphanumeric strings as "art". This catches outputs misclassifying punctuation or special characters as art.

name: no_single_character_person_entities
rationale: Correct outputs do not classify single-character entities as "person". This catches outputs with overly simplistic person entity extraction.

name: no_location_words_as_organization
rationale: Correct outputs do not classify location-specific words (e.g., countries or cities) as organizations. This catches misclassification of locations.

name: no_entities_with_internal_newlines
rationale: Correct outputs do not include entities with newlines inside them. This catches outputs with improperly formatted entities.

name: no_field_exceeding_reasonable_length
rationale: Correct outputs do not have unreasonably long lists of entities in any single field. This catches outputs with excessive or invalid extractions.

name: no_product_field_with_verbs
rationale: Correct outputs do not classify verbs as products. This catches outputs misclassifying actions or processes as products.

name: no_special_characters_in_person_field
rationale: Correct outputs do not classify entities with excessive special characters as "person". This catches outputs misclassifying improperly formatted names.

name: no_event_field_with_only_numbers
rationale: Correct outputs do not classify purely numeric entities as events. This catches outputs misclassifying years or other numbers as events.

name: no_duplicate_entities_across_fields
rationale: Correct outputs do not duplicate entities across different fields. This catches outputs where the same entity is extracted into multiple fields.

name: no_field_with_mostly_punctuation
rationale: Correct outputs do not classify strings of mostly punctuation as entities. This catches outputs with invalid or meaningless entities.

name: no_entities_with_leading_or_trailing_whitespace
rationale: Correct outputs trim whitespace from entities. This catches outputs with improperly formatted entities.

name: no_entities_with_internal_tabs
rationale: Correct outputs do not include entities containing tabs. This catches outputs with improperly formatted entities.

name: no_entities_with_repeated_words
rationale: Correct outputs do not include entities with the same word repeated consecutively. This catches outputs with improperly extracted entities.

name: no_empty_fields_with_entities_in_text
rationale: Correct outputs do not leave a field empty if entities of that type clearly exist in the text. This catches outputs missing obvious entities.

name: no_fields_with_nonsense_strings
rationale: Correct outputs do not classify gibberish or random strings as entities. This catches outputs with meaningless entities.

name: no_entities_with_disallowed_characters
rationale: Correct outputs do not include entities with disallowed characters (e.g., control characters). This catches outputs with invalid entities.

name: no_fields_with_unreasonably_long_entities
rationale: Correct outputs do not classify unreasonably long strings as single entities. This catches outputs with overly long or invalid entities.

name: no_entities_with_repeated_characters
rationale: Correct outputs do not include entities with excessive character repetition (e.g., "aaaaa"). This catches outputs with invalid extractions.

name: no_nonexistent_tokens
rationale: Every correct entity must consist of tokens that appear in the text. This catches outputs where entities contain words not present in the input context.

name: no_duplicate_entities_across_fields
rationale: Correct outputs do not duplicate the same entity across multiple fields. This catches outputs where an entity is mistakenly assigned to more than one category.

name: no_partial_span_matches
rationale: Correct entities match full spans in the text, not partial ones. This catches outputs where only part of a gold entity is extracted.

name: no_person_field_with_non_names
rationale: The "person" field should only contain proper names, not generic nouns like "person" or "people." This catches outputs where such generic terms are incorrectly labeled as persons.

name: no_building_field_with_generic_structures
rationale: Buildings must be named entities, not generic terms like "headquarters" or "house." This catches outputs where generic terms are labeled as buildings.

name: no_organization_field_with_generic_terms
rationale: Organizations must be named entities, not generic terms like "company" or "team." This catches outputs where such generic terms are labeled as organizations.

name: no_empty_strings_in_fields
rationale: Correct outputs do not have empty strings as entities. This catches outputs where an entity is mistakenly an empty string.

name: no_location_field_with_generic_places
rationale: Locations should be specific entities, not generic terms like "city" or "place." This catches outputs with such generic terms in the "location" field.

name: art_field_contains_titles
rationale: The "art" field should contain titles of works (e.g., books, films), not generic terms or non-title entities. This catches misclassifications in the "art" field.

name: no_overlap_within_field
rationale: Correct outputs have no duplicate entities within a single field. This catches outputs where entities are mistakenly repeated within the same field.

name: no_location_field_with_directional_terms
rationale: Locations should not contain standalone directional terms like "north" or "south." This catches misclassifications of such terms as locations.

name: no_event_field_with_generic_terms
rationale: Events should refer to specific named occurrences, not generic terms like "event" or "meeting." This catches such generic terms in the "event" field.

name: no_product_field_with_generic_terms
rationale: Products should refer to specific named items, not generic terms like "device" or "tool." This catches such generic terms in the "product" field.

name: no_other_field_with_generic_terms
rationale: The "other" field should not contain overly generic terms like "thing" or "item." This catches such terms in the "other" field.

name: no_miscategorized_buildings
rationale: Generic places like "headquarters" or "office" should not be misclassified as "building." This enforces accurate categorization.

name: no_miscategorized_persons
rationale: Non-person entities such as professions (e.g., "doctor," "lawyer") should not be misclassified as "person." This ensures proper categorization.

name: no_empty_fields
rationale: All fields in correct outputs should be present, even if they are empty lists. This ensures proper JSON structure and catches outputs missing fields.

name: field_values_are_lists
rationale: All field values must be lists in correct outputs. This ensures proper formatting and catches outputs with non-list field values.

name: no_duplicate_across_fields_and_case
rationale: Entities are unique across fields, regardless of case differences. This ensures case-insensitive uniqueness across fields.

name: no_misclassified_speakers
rationale: Titles or roles like "Dr." or "Professor" should not be labeled as "person" unless accompanied by a name. This ensures proper labeling of named individuals.

name: no_event_field_with_artifacts
rationale: Artifacts like "World Cup" belong in the "event" or "art" field but not both. This ensures proper classification of events and artifacts.

name: no_location_field_with_products
rationale: Product names should not be classified as locations. This ensures correct categorization of products.

name: no_event_field_with_dates_only
rationale: Dates or years alone (e.g., "2016") should not be labeled as events. This ensures events are more specific than just dates.

name: no_other_field_with_named_entities
rationale: Named entities (e.g., persons, locations) should not be misclassified as "other." This ensures proper categorization of named entities.
